narrative.intro: Csi Aviation obligated $1.1B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Csi Aviation won 8 awards so far, with an average award size of $143M and obligations up 73.7% year over year. Csi Aviation’s federal obligations rose through the last six fiscal years, from $2.4M in FY21 to $1.1B in FY26. Csi Aviation’s largest buyer in FY2026 to date is the Department of Homeland Security at $1.1B, followed by the Department of Defense at $1.7M and the Department of Energy at $721K. Csi Aviation’s primary NAICS market in FY2026 to date is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.1B, with Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M. Csi Aviation’s current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations. Csi Aviation’s award-value totals in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than contract obligations.

sections.heading: How fast is Csi Aviation growing?
sections.body: Csi Aviation’s obligations are up 73.7% year over year. Csi Aviation moved from $661M in FY25 to $1.1B in FY26. Csi Aviation has shown steady increases since FY21, when obligations were $2.4M.

sections.heading: Who are the main federal buyers for Csi Aviation?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the largest buyer for Csi Aviation at $1.1B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense purchased $1.7M and the Department of Energy purchased $721K in the same period.

faq.q: How much does Csi Aviation make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Csi Aviation obligated $1.1B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Csi Aviation won 8 awards this fiscal year so far, with an average award size of $143M and obligations up 73.7% year over year. Csi Aviation’s obligations increased from $661M in FY25 to $1.1B in FY26.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Csi Aviation?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security buys from Csi Aviation, obligating $1.1B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense and the Department of Energy also bought from Csi Aviation, obligating $1.7M and $721K respectively in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Csi Aviation sell to the government?
faq.a: Csi Aviation sells services in the travel and air transportation markets to the government. Csi Aviation’s primary NAICS market is All Other Travel Arrangement and Reservation Services at $1.1B in FY2026 to date, and Csi Aviation also shows work in Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation at $2.3M.
